user.title: Connect to Nimbio
user.description:
Paste a Nimbio API key.

- **Members**: create an account key at [api.nimbio.com/manage](https://api.nimbio.com/manage) — gives you open buttons for your keys.
- **Community managers**: create a community key in the [admin portal](https://community.nimbio.com) under API Access — adds live gate status and hold-open control.

A `nimbio_test_...` key exercises everything without moving a gate.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Nimbio
reauth_confirm.description: Your Nimbio API key was rejected (revoked or rotated). Paste a new key of the same type to reconnect.

webhook_mode.title: Live updates
webhook_mode.description:
How should Nimbio push gate status to Home Assistant?

- **Cloudhook** (recommended): uses your Nabu Casa cloud connection.
- **External URL**: your Home Assistant is already reachable over public https — enter that base URL.
- **Polling**: no push; state refreshes on an interval (status reads don't count against your monthly quota).
